item.title: Bulletin updated at 18:45 HKT 14/Mar/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the northeast monsoon moderating gradually in the middle and latter parts of this week, temperatures will rise gradually over the coast of southern China, it will be warm during the day. A fresh easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong on Sunday, and it will be replaced gradually by a humid southerly airstream in the following couple of days. A trough of low pressure will bring showers to southern China midweek next week.
